title: Quant defaults autopilot: sample-driven FP8/INT8 selection, calibration, and rollback playbook
creator: Ayesha Kapoor
description: Scope: Build an automated per-model default selector for quantization profiles (FP8 / INT8 presets) in the model catalog that is driven by a lightweight sampling and calibration workflow plus deterministic accuracy validation and rollout guardrails. Goals: 1) Recommend a safe default quant profile per model and provide a confidence band (high/medium/low) for production usage. 2) Produce reproducible calibration artifacts and a checksum/signature so operators can validate binaries. 3) Provide automatic fallback chains (e.g., FP8 -> INT8 -> FP16) governed by observed accuracy regressions and telemetry. Out of scope: full dataset-specific tuning UI and multi-stage distillation. This ticket focuses on the algorithm, CI gating, telemetry thresholds, and rollout automation for the catalog defaults.
acceptance_criteria: Catalog exposes a per-model recommended quantization profile string (eg. "fp8-e4m2-safeguard") with confidence label and rationale.
Calibration harness produces an artifact (quant-calib-{model}-{sha}.tar.gz) containing calibration stats, per-layer scale histograms, and a deterministic signature stored in the model catalog.
CI gates prevent merging model-default changes if primary eval metric delta exceeds configured thresholds (see telemetry_metrics below).
A canary rollout path exists: shadow traffic for 72h, 5% live traffic for 24h with automatic rollback if telemetry triggers fire.
Post-deploy alerting and dashboard show model-level accuracy deltas and token-latency tradeoffs for each quant profile applied.
Engineering docs + runbook created for manual intervention and emergency rollback.
Security review sign-off on artifact signing and storage (KMS integration documented).
implementation_notes: Step 1: Implement a sampling harness that draws stratified prompt buckets (N=2k by default) representative of on-platform distributions using dataset fingerprints.

Step 2: Run FP8 and INT8 calibration passes with fixed RNG seed and identical preprocessing; collect per-layer histograms, KL divergence to FP32 activations, and final decode output logits for a canonical prompt set.

Step 3: Compute validation scores: QA F1, instruction-following BLEU/ROUGE where applicable, and a normalized perplexity delta. Convert these into a single confidence score using weighted heuristics (weights configurable per model family).
Step 4: Store artifacts in catalog with immutable signature (KMS-signed) and link the recommended default profile to the artifact and validation snapshot.
Step 5: Add CI gating job (catalog-quant-validate) that replays canonical prompts and fails when accuracy delta > 1.5% absolute on primary metric or perplexity increase > 2.0%.

Step 6: Implement runtime fallback chain in serving runtime: prefer recommended profile; if latency or error SLOs breach or accuracy telemetry exceeds threshold, automatically switch to next-safe-profile.
Step 7: Provide admin APIs to force-rollout, force-rollback, and to review confidence artifacts via Console.
Note: Use sampling seed and calibration hyperparams stored with the artifact so calibration is reproducible for audits.
rollout_plan: Alpha: internal-only for 3 curated open-models (2 weeks) with manual validation by ML Research and SRE.
Beta: 10% of catalog models with shadow traffic for 72 hours, then 5% live traffic for 24 hours. Monitoring configured to auto-rollback on thresholds.
GA: enable catalog defaults as UI suggestion for all hosted models; Dedicated customers may opt-in. Default autopilot off for Private until KMS flows validated.
Emergency rollback: catalog service exposes a fast toggle to revert to FP16 default and to unseal previous artifact signature.
test_plan: Unit: calibrator functions produce identical histograms across runs with same seed.
Integration: catalog-quant-validate pipeline runs as part of PR checks against a 500-sample canonical suite.
Regression: nightly job that reruns full calibration on top-50 used models and stores trend metrics for 30 days.
Chaos: simulate a small drift in tokenizer output to exercise fallback chain behavior and alerting.
Shadow validation: compare FP8/INT8 outputs against FP16 in production shadow mode for 14 days before recommending GA default.
telemetry_metrics: primary_metric_delta: absolute drop on model primary metric (example: QA F1) — gate threshold 1.5%
perplexity_delta_pct: normalized perplexity increase — gate threshold 2.0%
generation_token_latency_ms: p95 latency budget per model (model-configurable)
error_rate: increase in decoding failures or OOMs (trigger if > 0.5% relative)
fallback_rate: percent of requests triggering runtime fallback (should be < 0.2% after stabilization)
updates: 2025-01-20: Kickoff sync with Research and SRE; agreed on canonical prompt buckets and initial sampling size (2k). Action: Research to provide initial buckets (Ayesha).

2025-01-28: Prototype calibration harness validated on 3 small models; deterministic signatures verified locally. Found discrepancy in tokenizer normalization — fixed normalization path in preprocessing (PR #5423).
2025-02-02: Design review — Console UI will show confidence band (green/yellow/red) and link to artifact. UX asked for a one-click 're-run calibration' button for catalog owners.

2025-02-04: SRE raised concern: artifact storage growth if we keep every calibration tarball. Decided to keep last 3 public calibration artifacts per model and archive older ones to cold storage. Action: Liam to implement retention policy.

2025-02-06: CI gating prototype merged to staging (github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pulls/5587). Staging run flagged one model where INT8 produced a 2.4% QA F1 regression; we will keep FP8 recommended for that model and add a model-specific override.
